brandMotifs.name: brand-glow
brandMotifs.value: three radial-gradient bulbs (#488DE9, #FE9921, #B2CFF7), blur 52-70px, transform-only drift keyframes
brandMotifs.purpose: The banner palette read as ambient light: floating blurred bulbs behind the hero, a small clipped wash on community links.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill CTA on the app's static primary (#005EB1 light / #A7C8FF dark).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--md-primary, #005eb1); color: var(--md-on-primary, #ffffff); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--md-primary, #005eb1) 88%, var(--md-on-primary, #ffffff)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--md-primary, #005eb1); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: Canonical blue/orange refraction logo from the app launcher foreground; decorative by default.
components.css: .ds-brand-mark { display: block; flex: none; object-fit: contain; }

components.name: Community Link
components.description: Quiet link card: container-low ground with a blurred brand wash at the trailing edge.
components.html: Join the communityTelegram
components.css: .ds-community-link { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 112px; border: 1px solid var(--md-outline-variant, #c4c6cf); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--md-surface-container-low, #f3f3fa); color: var(--md-on-surface, #191c20); text-decoration: none; } .ds-community-body { position: relative; z-index: 1; flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 20px 22px; } .ds-community-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-community-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-community-subtitle { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--md-on-surface-variant, #43474e); } .ds-community-art { position: absolute; top: -30%; right: -6%; width: 42%; height: 160%; background: radial-gradient(45% 34% at 38% 30%, #488de9, transparent 72%), radial-gradient(52% 40% at 62% 70%, #fe9921, transparent 74%); filter: blur(20px); opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; } .ds-community-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--md-primary, #005eb1); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: The app's own identity, worn plainly
narrative.overview: The docs site applies ReFra's canonical brand — the launcher mark, the banner palette expressed as floating blurred light, the app's static primary roles, and Google Sans — over generated neutral tones from the #247EE0 seed. Chrome stays quiet; brand color is earned by the mark, the ambient glow, and primary actions.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic paired roles for all text and controls
Banner colors as ambient blurred light, not literal diagonal bands
User-pinned atmosphere: blur, smooth motion, subtle gradients, restrained brand color

rules.name: Artwork vs UI
rules.body: --brand-* colors are for artwork surfaces; text and controls always use paired --md-* roles.

rules.name: Motion and atmosphere
rules.body: Blur, smooth animation, subtle gradients and restrained brand colors are preferred. Decorative floating motion only in the hero; controls respond with short transitions; reduced motion parks the glow, reduced transparency removes it.

dos: Do derive assets from the launcher/banner sources in the repo.
Do use ink #001C3B on pale brand grounds.
donts: Don't recolor the mark or use the mono/gallery launcher variants.
Don't spread the brand gradient over page backgrounds or small text.
